selection_rationale: Select consumption of replication_contact_record because the inventory identifies a specific producer asymmetry and a potentially consequential authority consumer that can be inspected locally. The snapshot-close candidate requires an unavailable client Persist contract or trace, while the pipeline-match candidate requires decoder behavior or a correlated transport execution.
